instructions: Score only the submitted diagnosis. Blind the evaluator to condition, tool trace, and run metrics.

criteria.anchor: Identifies that a scene command requested during update remains queued until the next begin-update flush, so render preparation still reads the previously published scene stack.
Connects update-time request, missing pre-render scene flush, stale stack IDs used for render extraction, and the visible extra frame.
Cites concrete relevant symbols or locations, including GameFramePipeline beginUpdate/prepareRender and SceneManager queued request/flush behavior.
Places the fix at the frame/scene commit boundary before render-store selection, while preserving world flush/publish ordering; does not blame renderer internals.
